description: Retrieve time-series values for a specific WHO Global Health Observatory indicator. Filter by country (ISO alpha-3), year range, and sex (both sexes, male, or female). Returns numeric values with confidence intervals for indicators such as life expectancy at birth (WHOSIS_000001), DTP3 immunization coverage (dptv), TB incidence (MDG_0000000020), and 3,000+ more. Use who.indicator_search to find indicator codes. No auth — unlimited free.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code to filter results (e.g. "USA", "FRA", "IND").

indicator_code.description: WHO GHO indicator code (e.g. "WHOSIS_000001" for life expectancy, "dptv" for DTP3 immunization, "MORT_100" for mortality). Use who.indicator_search to find codes.

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return (1–100, default 20).

sex.description: Sex dimension filter: SEX_BTSX (both sexes), SEX_MLE (male), SEX_FMLE (female).

year_from.description: Start year for time series data (inclusive, e.g. 2015).

year_to.description: End year for time series data (inclusive, e.g. 2023).

name: who.health.indicator_data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: WHO GHO — Get Indicator Data
